title: errorsframe
summary: Live UIErrorsFrame parity is implemented as a dedicated law-positioned 512x60 TOP/HIGH message frame with three newest-first 20px lines, ErrorFont styling, independent 5-second hold plus 3-second fade, and the reference yellow info/red error classes. Spell, loot, taxi, control, quest kill/item/completion, and other live producers route through the shared sink; the parity fixture is fallback-only.

openItems.text: No live UIErrorsFrame: no fixed 512x60 top-anchored 3-line message area with newest-on-top insert, 5s hold and fade
No yellow UI_INFO_MESSAGE class (quest objective-progress toasts) - only red error-styled pushes exist
Parity stub is not wired to real errors (hardcoded message, shown only when armed)
